question: What decision currently governs annotation evaluation semantics? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-563 currently governs annotation evaluation semantics through the postponed evaluation of annotations design.
The authority evidence for PEP-563 is documented in the Python PEPs repository at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/e3010cb7d2c4a1aaf285170e49227859386a3316/pep-0563.rst with Accepted status.
